title: Rules; specific.
bodyText: The director may establish by rule the criteria for siting design, construction, financial responsibility, manifest, and operation of solid waste management systems.
bodyHtml: §342H-31  Rules; specific.  The director may establish by rule the criteria for siting design, construction, financial responsibility, manifest, and operation of solid waste management systems. [L 1989, c 212, pt of §4; am L 1998, c 226, §3]
